Definition: a fastness (as a covert of ambush)
BiblicalUsage: David dwelt in the castle at Jerusalem, hid in the strong holds of the wilderness of Ziph while Saul sought him daily, and Isaiah promises the righteous a place of defence in the munitions of rocks. The word is the fastness, the stronghold where a man hides and holds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the stronghold is where David learned to trust: Saul sought him every day and God delivered him not into his hand, because the true fastness was the Lord Himself. Saul sought him every day, and God delivered him not into his hand.
